_note: 58 companies across 3 ATS platforms plus 1 custom-domain company (Session 18 grew this from 9 to 47 by guessing ATS slugs from company names and validating against the live API — 34 new Greenhouse + 4 new Lever, ~14% hit rate, 3 slug collisions caught and rejected. Session 19 grew it further to 58 by inverting the method: fetching each candidate's own real career page and reading its actual ATS directly off of it — 1 new Greenhouse + 10 new Comeet, lower raw hit rate but zero collision risk and the first real Comeet discoveries since Sessions 1-13's seed set. See ARCHITECTURE.md/PROGRESS.md Session 18/19 notes for the honest shortfall against the ~200 Greenhouse target and the sourcing methods). 2 entries (Optimove/Mobileye) are EU-region-hosted, live-verified in Session 13. This is still NOT the ~8,000-9,000-company target universe. Harvesting the full list happens via Claude Code sessions per ADR-0023, not as part of routine scans.
